name: palate-beta
description: BETA, EXPECTED TO HAVE BUGS. The unstable track of the Palate website-builder, published so testers can opt in. Do not run it alongside palate-website-builder: both register hooks on plain Write, so two manifest recorders would write the same build-manifest.json and double-count MCP calls. Install one at a time. Builds and maintains production-grade Astro websites grounded by the Palate MCP: scaffold a new site, or add pages, sections and features to an existing one (CONTINUE mode) with the same taste rigour. Also converts brand assets into a four-format design-token package. Connect the Palate MCP with one `claude mcp add --scope user` command (token from app.palatemcp.com).
